idea-plugin.name: Bisotun Flow Extractor
idea-plugin.description:
Instantly Extract Execution Call Flows & Data Models

Bisotun Flow Extractor automates code navigation by tracing and extracting nested execution call hierarchies and related data models directly to your clipboard in clean Markdown format—ideal for context injection into LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, Ollama) or team documentation.

Why "Bisotun"? The Philosophy Beneath the Name

The plugin is named after Mount Bisotun, a majestic peak located near Kermanshah, Iran, famous for holding the world's largest limestone cliff and the historic Bisotun Inscription—carved in three ancient cuneiform languages (Old Persian, Elamite, and Babylonian) by command of Darius the Great.

Just as Mount Bisotun is structured in magnificent, enduring geological layers, complex software code is also built layer upon layer. Bisotun Flow Extractor dives deep through these architectural layers to unearth, decode, and document your call flows and data models with historical precision.

Key Features:

  • Deep Flow Extraction: Recursively crawls method execution call chains up to configurable depths.
  • Model Crawler: Automatically extracts referenced DTOs, Entities, and Interfaces.
  • Multi-Language Support: Seamless support for Java, Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript (including React JSX/TSX), even in IntelliJ IDEA Community edition!
  • LLM-Optimized Markdown: Generates structured markdown trees ready to be pasted into AI prompts.

Shortcuts:

  • Ctrl + Alt + Shift + D : Copy Deep Flow (Calls + Models)
  • Ctrl + Alt + Shift + S : Copy Shallow Flow (Calls + Models)
  • Ctrl + Alt + Shift + M : Copy Shallow Flow (No Models)
  • Ctrl + Alt + Shift + C : Copy Method Only
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.5

  • Added robust multi-language flow extraction support for Python (`.py`, `pyw`, `pyi`) with full absolute/relative import resolution.
  • Resolved IntelliJ IDEA module classloader constraints via optional Java dependencies, enabling seamless multi-IDE compatibility (IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm).

1.0.4

  • Added inline animated GIF demo inside the plugin description for direct viewing in IntelliJ IDEA client.

1.0.3

  • Added official branded plugin icon and visual assets.
  • Enhanced plugin description with the historical and architectural philosophy of Mount Bisotun.

1.0.2

  • Added full flow extraction support for JS, JSX, TS, and TSX files in IntelliJ Community.
  • Refactored architecture into a unified dispatcher strategy for improved stability.
